newsitem.title: USA: Cellular network equipment market to grow - study.
newsitem.headline: Cellular network equipment market to grow - study.

text.p: The world market for cellular network equipment will achieve a 6.7 percent compound annual growth rate and exceed $31 billion by the year 2000, according to a new study.
Growth will be driven by opportunities in developing markets and efforts to build personal communications services (PCS) networks in the United States, the study said.
The report, World Cellular Network Equipment Markets, was published by Northern Business Information.

Sweden's L.M. Ericsson AB and Motorola Inc dominated the cellular network equipment market in 1995, with 31.2 percent and 21.7 percent market share, respectively, as measured by 1995 systems revenues.
U.S.-based Lucent Technologies Inc was in third place and Finland's Nokia Ab came in fourth, the report said.
Northern Business Information is a research and consulting firm covering the global telecommunications market. It is a division of Datapro Information Services Group, a unit of the McGraw-Hill Cos.
